meta.name: marketing-analytics
meta.description: Sets up, audits, and reports on marketing measurement — tracking plans, event schemas, attribution models, and the dashboards built on them. Use this to instrument a site or product, audit tracking nobody trusts, choose or interpret an attribution model, build reporting that answers a specific question, or reconcile numbers that disagree between tools.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建可信的营销衡量与归因体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的营销数据来自多个工具,想统一衡量效果
copy.tagline_en: Set up reliable marketing measurement and attribution reporting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your marketing data sits across many tools and you need one reliable view.

howto.what: Claude 会坚持先写书面追踪计划(要记录的事件、属性和用途),再配置或检查;检查时要你亲自触发一次动作来确认数据到达;报告只回答一个问题、面向一个读者,并写清归因口径和对比周期。
howto.when: 当你想给网站或产品加转化统计、怀疑现有追踪不准,或需要选择/解释归因模型等营销衡量需求时,该技能就会接管。

say.text: 我要给网站做转化统计,先帮我拟一份追踪计划。
say.note: 会要求明确事件名、属性以及要回答的问题。

say.text: 我的数据好像不准,帮我查一下现有追踪有什么问题。
say.note: 会请你亲自做一遍动作,查看事件是否如实送达。

say.text: 本月各渠道贡献,请用首触归因模型出报表并说明为什么。
say.note: 会限定报告要回答的问题,注明模型与对比期。

howto.what_en: Claude demands a written tracking plan before auditing or instrumenting. Audits mean triggering an event yourself and checking delivery. Reports answer one audience/question, naming model/comparison.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add tracking to a site or product, audit questionable tracking, or choose/interpret an attribution model; other marketing measurement requests will trigger it too.

say_en.text: We need conversion tracking for the site; draft a tracking plan first.
say_en.note: Event names, properties, and their purpose.

say_en.text: Our numbers look off; audit the current tracking setup.
say_en.note: Guides you through one event to check that it arrives.

say_en.text: Report this month's channels with first-touch attribution and explain why.
say_en.note: It scopes the question and states the model/comparison.
